CardDescription.DefaultText:
Can be found in pine clearings during at the end of autumn and start of winter. Needs high acidity, low to medium hydration and low nutrients.

Will grow when conditions are right.
CardDescription.Text: 可在秋末冬初的松木林隙中找到。需要高酸度、中低湿度和低养分。\n\n条件适宜时即会生长。
